run_coco_evaluation: run COCO-style AP and AR evaluation on BOP22 detection result files via argparse CLI
validate_coco_results: validate COCO result file format using inout.check_coco_results before running evaluation
merge_coco_annotations: merge per-scene COCO annotations and results across multiple scenes using pycoco_utils
filter_by_targets: filter COCO annotations and results by estimation targets from test_targets_bop19.json
save_coco_scores: save computed COCO scores including AP, AR metrics, and average inference time to JSON
